paragraphs.text: The proposer acknowledges that all inquiries and communications regarding this RFP must be conducted exclusively via email to the designated address, bids@syrairport.org. This ensures compliance with the Authority's specified communication protocol.

The proposer confirms that their contact information, including email address, has been provided to the Authority as required. Additionally, the proposer has ensured that their interest in the RFP has been communicated to the Authority through the specified email address.
The proposer is prepared to provide any additional information requested by the Authority. The engineering lead is available for interviews or further clarification as needed.
